title: Witnessing Excellence in Action: The 'Other-Praising' Emotions of Elevation, Gratitude, and Admiration

publication.publisher_or_container: The Journal of Positive Psychology, vol. 4, no. 2, pp. 105-127

verification.verification_notes: Citation, volume, pages, DOI, and PMCID confirmed. Four studies (recall, video induction, event-contingent diary, letter-writing) establish elevation as a distinct other-praising emotion motivating prosocial and emulative behaviour.

copyright.notes: Author manuscript available via PMC; analytical citation only, no text reproduced.
